objectives.ai_eng: AI engineer who builds LLM applications end to end: retrieval, LangGraph workflows with human review, and evaluation with documented failure cases. Led an 8-person team that shipped a meeting transcription and summary tool, after building Azure data pipelines in consulting.
objectives.data_eng: Data engineer who has built batch ETL/ELT pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks for enterprise clients, written PySpark and SQL against Delta Lake tables and star and snowflake schemas, and set up data quality checks and reconciliation before data reaches reports.
objectives.data_analyst: Data analyst with a background in SQL, data validation, and reporting: reconciliation queries across source systems, Power BI reports for client questions, and dashboards for government and public audiences.
objectives.data_sci: Data scientist with postgraduate ML training (PyTorch, TensorFlow, MLflow) and a focus on measurement: set transcription and readability metrics against a commercial baseline and checked label reliability with Cohen's kappa.
objectives.research_data: Research data analyst focused on data quality: merged messy sources (scanned PDFs, CSVs, legacy SQL, Excel) with integrity checks, applied tiered quality rules in production pipelines, and built hand-checked gold sets.
